notes: Cross-verse split on supplied case prepositions. Everywhere else in this chapter a supplied English preposition marking a Greek case relation stays with the case-marked word (27:31 *from him*, 27:2 and 27:58 *to Pilate*, 27:53 *unto many*, 27:55 *unto him*, 27:56 *of James*), while a particle belonging to the English lexical gloss of the verb stays with the verb (*ask for* at 27:20 and 27:58, *rail on* at 27:39, *witness against* at 27:13). This verse alone put a case-marking *unto* on the verb. `ποιέω` is glossed *do* throughout the corpus, so *unto* answers to the accusative of the person, not to the verb's English idiom.
